**Verdict: PASS.** I found no new findings on DG1 candidate `sha256:6e0c0db1…6f827` (commit `642e6bf`, 395 files). My record is at `docs/delivery/reviews/DG1/round-4/qa-verifier.json` and validates against the review schema; all 39 evidence paths exist. The narrative is alongside it, and logs are under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG1/qa/round-4/`.

**Candidate identity.** The recomputed candidate ID matched the assignment at the start and end of the run, both in the repository and in a disposable clone at `642e6bf`. HEAD moved twice during the run, but only through freeze metadata and the other reviewers' run evidence, which the candidate hash excludes. I did not read any other round-4 review record.

**The only change this round (F-DG1-147, the e2e typecheck):**
- `pnpm -r typecheck` passes, and now also type-checks the `apps/web` e2e specs.
- My own negative test confirms it catches errors. A type error injected into `apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts` or `playwright.config.ts` makes the typecheck fail with exit 2, directly and through `pnpm -r typecheck`. After reverting, it passes again.
- CI's verify job runs `pnpm typecheck`, so this check also runs in CI.

**No regressions anywhere else:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Build, lint, format, OpenAPI lint, no-CDN | all pass |
| Unit tests, Node 22 and Node 24 | 326/326 on each |
| Integration on a disposable PostgreSQL, run twice | 209/209 each time (9 migrations; bu-hierarchy-guard 7/7; contract 9/9 including getBrandingTokens) |
| A12/A13/A14 | 24/24 |
| E2E journeys, English and Arabic, one worker | 18/18, no skips |
| QA acceptance run, including A20 | 22/22 |
| A20 token propagation | pass |
| A18 clean start at the candidate commit | pass |
| Gate validator (`--register DG1`, `--pipeline`, `--reconcile`) | pass |
| Database checks, static requirement checks, contrast, fonts | pass; static output identical to round 3 |
| Earlier black-box and worker-stop checks | pass |

**Known gaps, not blocking (as the assignment and decisions D-057/D-058 specify):**
- **Live CI run (A24, REQ-DLV-025, D-058):** not run, because the sandbox has no CI runner. The offline checks passed: the CI workflow copies are identical, the job dependencies are correct, 46/46 script tests pass, three tampered workflows were rejected, and a tampered gate record makes the pipeline check fail.
- **Live-registry install (REQ-DLV-042, D-057):** 13 of 14 offline checks pass. The one failure (AC-1 effect) is because the registry is unreachable (connection refused at the proxy), not a candidate defect.
- **`pnpm deps:verify`:** needs the live registry. It hung and I stopped it. It isn't one of my assigned checks, so I recorded it as informational only.

**Mistakes I made during the run, both recorded and neither affecting the candidate:**
- My first A24 attempt is void: I hadn't copied each package's dependencies into the clone. The log is kept and marked VOID.
- One process-kill command matched and ended my own shell.

All execution happened in disposable clones, which I have since deleted.

**Findings:** none. F-DG1-230, 231 and 232 stay CLOSED_VERIFIED.
